dependency_policy: Wait for every BORA budget and free dedicated resources
recipe: Released OptFormer rank_samples policy: 3 random starts, then 100 prior samples ranked by learned EI
evaluation_budget: 100 actual calls; failures/timeouts included; repeated valid proposals consume a call; no final refit
cpu_policy: ToSFiT 3 evaluation cores; OptFormer 1 serial / 3 parallel
training_adaptation: 249M T5.1.1-base from scratch on 413 train80 trajectories; 97 held-out train80 validation trajectories
known_limitations: Strong training/validation overfit; dry runs establish execution, not competitive performance
Checkpoint100000 is the requested final model; step2000 best validation weights are unavailable
Separate inference subprocess reloads the model each proposal; measured short-history cost around one minute
Invalid infrastructure/model failures stop visibly; automatic process retries disabled
Dry runs used held-out pc4/lightgbm and train80 abalone/gradient_boosting; production starts fresh
memory_policy: JAX allocator 20% of 80GB per worker; max two OptFormer workers per GPU

recommendation_policy.name: configspace-default-repair-v3-whole-default-fallback
recommendation_policy.parameter_errors: Use each missing or invalid parameter default, preserving valid assignments
recommendation_policy.unrecoverable_configuration: Evaluate the labelled complete ConfigSpace default
recommendation_policy.provenance: Save raw suggestion, repairs, final configuration and whether EI applies to it
recommendation_policy.infrastructure_errors: Stop visibly on model, checkpoint, context or GPU failure

execution_plan: Seven ToSFiT tasks; up to sixteen OptFormer evaluators under existing resource guards
